roadmap.goal: Slice 01: the ServiceNow query field says what to put in it. Two nullable schema fields (placeholder + helpText) carried by the data-retrieval schema in BOTH twins, rendered on the TextField that already exists, so a flow coach facing a blank 'ServiceNow Query (Encoded Query)' box is told what a query looks like, where to get one, and which two silent-failure modes to avoid — instead of hitting the query_matches_whole_table block with no instruction.
roadmap.overview: Two steps, backend twin then frontend twin. 01-01 adds Placeholder + HelpText to DataRetrievalSchemaDto and populates them for the ServiceNow TEAM row only. 01-02 mirrors the pair in the TypeScript twin, renders them on the existing TextField, and closes the cross-stack enforcement test that asserts the two twins say the same thing. RED-by-skip is the project convention: DISTILL authored the scenarios and marked them [Ignore]/.skip so main stays green; each step un-skips its own scenarios and implements to GREEN.

validation.notes: Authored by the orchestrator rather than dispatched to nw-solution-architect: DD-5 in the DESIGN sections already specifies the two fields, their nullability, both twins, and the AC-A1/AC-A2 rendering contract, so re-deriving a plan would restate a design that was written and reviewed hours earlier. Scope is 4 production files. Slice 02 (the board picker) is a SEPARATE roadmap and is NOT in scope here.

open_questions_resolved.copy_is_unwritten: U-2 in the DISTILL upstream issues: the guidance prose does not exist yet. The tests pin three load-bearing tokens rather than a sentence — 'whole table' (an unknown FIELD NAME is dropped and the query returns everything, which ValidateTeamSettings then blocks), 'nothing' (a bad VALUE silently returns no rows), and 'Copy query' (ServiceNow's own right-click breadcrumb path). The crafter DRAFTS the copy against those constraints; the maintainer reviews the wording at the slice-01 dogfood. Do not invent a fourth failure mode, and do not name a ServiceNow UI element the SPIKE did not observe.
open_questions_resolved.why_two_fields_not_one: DD-5. AC-A1 asks for a worked example visible when the field is EMPTY and guidance legible when it is FILLED. Those are two MUI props with two lifetimes — placeholder disappears on input, helperText does not. One field cannot satisfy both halves.
open_questions_resolved.portfolio_untouched: AC-A6. The ServiceNow PORTFOLIO schema is inputKind 'none' and its field is never rendered, so it gets null for both new fields. A portfolio row carrying guidance for a field that does not exist would be dead data.

The RBAC gate on wizard buttons (DD-8, slice 02)

steps.implementation_notes: The DTO already carries DisplayLabel, InputKind, IsRequired, IsWorkItemTypesRequired and the dead WizardHint — add the pair beside them and follow the existing null-by-default idiom exactly. Do NOT overload WizardHint (D5): it is a wizard id, it is read by nothing in the frontend, and giving it a second meaning makes it harder to either use or delete. Copy is drafted here, reviewed at dogfood — see open_questions_resolved.copy_is_unwritten for the three tokens the tests pin and why.

steps.scenario_name: the ServiceNow query guidance says the same thing on both stacks
steps.implementation_notes:
MUI renders no helper

element at all for a falsy helperText, so AC-A2's no-empty-helper-row requirement is satisfied structurally rather than by a conditional — do not add one. The enforcement test compares SOURCE TEXT across the two twins (the formatLikelihood.enforcement.test.ts pattern), so the C# and TS strings must match exactly, not merely agree in spirit. Do NOT branch on systemType inside the component (D3): the schema is where connector knowledge already lives, and branching there is the twin-drift anti-pattern pointing the other way. GeneralSettingsComponent.test.tsx line 1100 ('does not offer it to someone who cannot open it') is the DD-8 RBAC gate and belongs to SLICE 02 — leave it skipped.

steps.scenario_name: A ServiceNow team's query field shows a worked example of the query it wants
steps.implementation_notes: Added at the orchestrator's review of 01-02, not planned up front. The example shipped by 01-01/01-02 was `active=true^assignment_group=Service Desk`, which selects ZERO rows: `assignment_group` is a reference field storing a sys_id, so matching it against a display label matches nothing. That is the exact second failure mode the help text beside it warns about, so the product would have handed a coach a broken example and then implied the mistake was theirs. Inherited from DD-5's illustration and carried through DISTILL and both twins without anyone running it — the same not-re-measured pattern that produced the three SPIKE corrections. Replacement uses non-reference fields only, so it cannot hit the label-vs-sys_id trap on any instance.

steps.name: Show the guidance where the team is created, and say less
criteria: The Create Team wizard renders the placeholder and help text — the real AC-A5, which shipped broken
The help text is one instruction and nothing else: 'To get an encoded query, filter a list in ServiceNow, right-click the filter breadcrumb, and choose Copy query' (AC-A4 withdrawn)
A regression pin renders the CREATE-wizard path, not GeneralSettingsComponent
Both suites green, both builds warning-free, both twins byte-identical
steps.scenario_name: shows a worked example in the empty field and the guidance beneath it
steps.implementation_notes: Both fixes came from the maintainer dogfooding slice 01, not from any gate. (a) AC-A5's premise that ModifyTeamSettings and CreateTeamWizard 'render through the same GeneralSettingsComponent' is FALSE — that component is imported by two files and the create wizard is not one of them. The test asserted against the component the wizard does not use, so it passed while the surface the whole slice exists to fix showed nothing. Fixed by plumbing dataRetrievalPlaceholder / dataRetrievalHelpText props to CreateWizardShell; CreatePortfolioWizard shares the shell but stays blank on its own because its inputKind is 'none'. (b) The help text was cut to a single actionable instruction at the maintainer's call, withdrawing AC-A4; the two silent-failure modes it used to name now have no in-product home and are handed to #5578's docs.
